items.text: Breaking news! Seaty just reached 100 subscribers, so the whole city is having a festival. And look who just landed at Fly For Ever's airport: two very famous visitors, staying for a whole week.
They took the brightest car in town and cruised straight down to the lake. Welcome to Seaty!
And tonight, the whole city celebrates. Fireworks over the lake, balloons, music, and a giant golden one hundred. Thank you, all one hundred of you!
